title: Why Websites Check Your Exact Battery Percentage

vo.en: Check your battery percentage right now.

visual.description: Macro shot of a man's thumb tapping on an illuminated smartphone screen showing a battery level indicator.

vo.en: Modern websites don't just track cookies; they quietly access a hidden browser tool called the Battery Status API.

visual.description: Fast-moving lines of glowing green code and data packets scrolling rapidly down a dark monitor screen.

vo.en: It reads your exact charge level and drain speed down to several decimal places in real time.

visual.description: Futuristic telemetry HUD interface displaying rapidly changing percentages and battery discharge graph vectors.

vo.en: Here is the creepy part: going incognito or using a VPN will not protect you.

visual.description: A man in a dark room illuminated only by multiple bright computer screens reflecting off his glasses.

vo.en: Data brokers combine this microscopic data to instantly reconstruct your identity across totally separate browsers.

visual.description: Tower of enterprise server racks with pulsing blue and amber LEDs inside a futuristic server room corridor.
